summary: Backend regression testing for SEMEX hit-submission + Telegram-forwarding pipeline. Verified the fingerprint-mismatch soft-pass fix in deps.get_current_user and confirmed POST /api/data/status persists hits and correctly gates forwarding. All 11 pytest cases PASS (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: deps.get_current_user + get_current_user_allow_expired now correctly treat fingerprint mismatch as a soft-pass (WARNING log) rather than 401 — verified by test and observed in backend logs.
routes/data.py POST /api/data/status inserts hits BEFORE the forward attempt, so DB persistence is decoupled from Telegram delivery (good — user's original bug of 'nothing saved' is prevented).
Forwarding gate 'should_forward' (charged OR live) correctly returns forwarded:false for declined/dead hits without dropping the DB insert.

Minor observation (not a blocker): admin.list_all_hits returns Mongo docs directly; screenshot_b64 is properly excluded via projection. If additional binary fields are added later, remember to extend the projection.

Minor observation: /api/admin/users route in admin.py uses hasattr(pe,'isoformat') for one path but assumes datetime for created_at/last_seen_at — safe only if seed always stores datetimes (currently true).
test_credentials: Seeded via /app/backend/tests/conftest.py: active non-admin tid=999000222, expired non-admin tid=999000111, admin tid=999000333 (test admin, not the real @CARAXSS). All cleaned up after session.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral users/sessions/hits created inside pytest fixtures with telegram_ids 999000111/222/333/444; deleted at session teardown. Verified DB is clean afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 11 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_hit_pipeline.py fully cover: (1) missing auth 401, (2) revoked session 401, (3) matching fp -> 200 + persisted, (4) MISMATCHED fp -> 200 + persisted (core regression), (5) no fp header -> 200, (6) charged hit forwarded=true + persisted, (7) declined hit forwarded=false + persisted, (8) admin GET /api/admin/hits lists newly inserted hits (filter by telegram_id), (9) non-admin GET /api/admin/hits -> 403, (10) expired non-admin POST -> 402, (11) admin POST always succeeds. Run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_hit_pipeline.py -v`. Telegram sendMessage will emit 'chat not found' warnings for the fake test IDs — that is expected and does not affect assertions (we only assert DB + endpoint status + forwarded flag).
rca of the issue: Pre-existing bug (already fixed by main agent, this run only verifies): popup and background script derived slightly different fingerprint strings; the JWT was minted with popup's fp, then POST /api/data/status arrived with background's X-Fingerprint header. deps.get_current_user raised HTTPException(401, 'Fingerprint mismatch') BEFORE the db.hits.insert_one call in routes/data.py:submit_status, so no hit was ever persisted and no Telegram forward was attempted. Fix applied: the X-Fingerprint != token.fp branch now only logs a WARNING (soft-pass) — the JWT signature + non-revoked session already authenticate the request strongly. Verified in logs: 'WARNING semex.deps: fingerprint mismatch (soft) sid=... tid=...' followed by a successful insert + response. Test test_mismatched_fingerprint_still_saves_hit specifically covers this regression.
